column1: //step Layout | | The first line of a model chooses the direction the whole diagram is drawn in. This page is drawn from left to right.

//step The first line | The first line | The first line reads "double slash" //flowchart followed by a direction. Without it a model is drawn from left to right. The older "double slash" //graph form draws the same diagrams but cannot link whole subgraphs.
//step Left to right | Left to right | LR draws from left to right. It suits long chains of links and wide screens.
//step Top to bottom | Top to bottom | TB draws from top to bottom. It suits tall pages and models that branch out.
//step Bottom to top | Bottom to top | BT draws from bottom to top.
//step Right to left | Right to left | RL draws from right to left.
//step The fix option | The fix option | Adding the word fix to the end of the first line was needed with older versions of Mermaid. It makes no difference now and can be left out.
